lines.en: You need to get cars across the sea. But giant ships pass through here every day, so a bridge is out.
lines.texto: You need to get cars across the sea. But giant ships pass through here every day, so a bridge is out.

lines.en: So you start digging a tunnel from the beach, straight under the water.
lines.texto: So you start digging a tunnel from the beach, straight under the water.

lines.en: And the sea says: thank you very much, and pours right in.
lines.texto: And the sea says: thank you very much, and pours right in.

lines.en: So this time, you don't dig under the sea. You dig on the bottom of it. A dredger scoops out a long trench across the seabed.
lines.texto: So this time, you don't dig under the sea. You dig on the bottom of it. A dredger scoops out a long trench across the seabed.

lines.en: Then you spread a perfectly flat bed of gravel along the bottom of the trench.
lines.texto: Then you spread a perfectly flat bed of gravel along the bottom of the trench.

lines.en: Meanwhile, on the shore, you build a giant dry pit next to the sea.
lines.texto: Meanwhile, on the shore, you build a giant dry pit next to the sea.

lines.en: Inside it, you cast huge hollow boxes of concrete. These are the pieces of your tunnel.
lines.texto: Inside it, you cast huge hollow boxes of concrete. These are the pieces of your tunnel.

lines.en: You seal both ends of every piece with steel walls, so not a single drop gets in.
lines.texto: You seal both ends of every piece with steel walls, so not a single drop gets in.

lines.en: Now you flood the dock. And the concrete box... floats! It's full of air, so it behaves like a ship.
lines.texto: Now you flood the dock. And the concrete box... floats! It's full of air, so it behaves like a ship.

lines.en: Tugboats drag it out to sea, right above the trench.
lines.texto: Tugboats drag it out to sea, right above the trench.

lines.en: You fill tanks inside it with water, and it slowly sinks, down onto the gravel bed.
lines.texto: You fill tanks inside it with water, and it slowly sinks, down onto the gravel bed.

lines.en: Each piece has a fat rubber seal on its end. You pull it tight against the last piece.
lines.texto: Each piece has a fat rubber seal on its end. You pull it tight against the last piece.

lines.en: Then you pump out the water trapped between them. And now the whole sea pushes on the other end, squeezing the joint shut. Free pressure!
lines.texto: Then you pump out the water trapped between them. And now the whole sea pushes on the other end, squeezing the joint shut. Free pressure!

lines.en: Piece after piece, the tunnel crosses the whole strait.
lines.texto: Piece after piece, the tunnel crosses the whole strait.

lines.en: You bury it under tons of rock, so anchors and currents can never touch it.
lines.texto: You bury it under tons of rock, so anchors and currents can never touch it.

lines.en: Knock out the steel walls, pave the road, turn on the lights. Congratulations! You have built a tunnel under the sea.
